source.curation: manual synthetic cases based on canonical Skill names/descriptions and cross-skill boundaries

scoring_policy.acceptable: acceptable_skills are permitted but not required and do not increase recall
scoring_policy.excluded: excluded_skills are counted as false positives
scoring_policy.order: expected_order is an ordered subsequence unless order_is_advisory is true
scoring_policy.human_review: needs_human_review cases are excluded from aggregate metrics
